name: Pump.fun
thesis: Insider unlocks add 4.5% of circulating PUMP over 90 days, the 7-day fee run-rate has slipped below the 30-day, and price sits near its 30-day low. The balance of evidence tilts lower, but not strongly enough for a directional view.

note.name: Pump.fun
note.horizonLabel: over the next 8 weeks, into the 11 Dec cliff
note.thesis: Insider unlocks add 4.5% of circulating PUMP over 90 days, the 7-day fee run-rate has slipped below the 30-day, and price sits near its 30-day low. The balance of evidence tilts lower, but not strongly enough for a directional view.
note.what: Pump.fun is a Solana launchpad. Anyone can mint a memecoin for free; it trades on a bonding curve until the curve fills, then liquidity moves to the PumpSwap AMM. Creators and short-horizon traders pay trading fees. PUMP is not needed to use the product and gives no claim on revenue; the project says half of platform revenue buys and burns it.

points.text: 30-day fees annualise $1.68B against $1.23B over the trailing year, but the last 7 days annualise $1.27B, so the run-rate has slipped.
DefiLlama's schedule has 20.625B PUMP unlocking over 90 days from 12 Nov — Team 12.500B and Existing Investors 8.125B — with 6.875B cliffs on 11 Dec and 11 Jan.

points.bold: Burn is the only token sink
points.text: The project says half of platform revenue buys PUMP on the open market and burns it; 176.38B PUMP burned and $505.07M deployed to date.
CoinGecko closes show $0.00364, against a 30-day high of $0.00513 on 22 Oct and a low of $0.00350 on 11 Nov, on 30-day realised volatility of 5.6% a day.
Daily burns near $0.5M continue and price sits in the lower-middle of its 1σ band, so the bear case is drift rather than a break.

note.supplyText: Supply grows over the next 90 days and the recipients are insiders only; the documented path may understate what arrives. DefiLlama marks the 24% Community and Ecosystem allocation as not followed and TBD, while max supply is 1.000T against 823.354B minted.
note.valuationHeadline: Revenue, not fees, funds the burn
note.valuationText: PUMP's only cash-flow link is the buyback, which the project funds from revenue, not gross fees, so revenue is the multiple that matters. The coin trades at 4.9x FDV/annualised revenue against Pons at 5.7x and Graphite Protocol at 1.5x; there are too few traded peers for a median.
note.usageText: Fees come from memecoin trading on the bonding curve and on PumpSwap; the project keeps $607.88M of that annualised 30-day activity as revenue. No cause has been identified for the recent slowdown. Tokenless competitors still earn: Flap sh at $4.69M of 30-day revenue, StonkFun at $2.99M and BONK.fun Launchpad at $1.61M.

catalysts.text: First new insider unlock tokens on the documented schedule
6.875B cliff, 1.5% of float, split Team and Existing Investors

risks.title: Buyback could slow
risks.text: The burn is discretionary and funded by trading revenue; a further drop in volume would remove the offset to insider supply.

risks.title: Fee run-rate recovers
risks.text: If the 7-day pace climbs back above the 30-day, the deceleration behind the lower tilt disappears.

risks.title: Unlock passes absorbed
risks.text: The 4.5% insider release landing without price damage, with the coin holding above the $0.00350 30-day low, would undercut the lower half.

risks.title: Community schedule resumes
risks.text: DefiLlama marks the 24% Community and Ecosystem allocation as not followed and TBD; resumed releases would add supply beyond the documented path.

watchlist.item: Pump.fun deposits to Kraken: 76,111 SOL (~$6.85M), cumulative 5,553,833 SOL reported
Near-term unlock date disputed: 11 Nov story against DefiLlama's 12 Nov first tokens
Buyback-and-burn commitment has no confirmed end date
Points or paid incentive farming on Pump.fun

note.positioningText: Hyperliquid funding is +0.0081%/8h now and +0.0052%/8h on a 7-day average. Open interest across exchanges is $58M, down 13.5% over seven days, and the long/short account ratio is 0.74 (42% long).
note.conclusion: Fees are still large and the burn still runs, but the 7-day pace has fallen below the 30-day while insider tokens arrive into a weak price. Funding sits inside its usual range, so positioning is not a driver. The balance tilts to the lower half of the range, not far enough for a directional view.
note.invalidation: 7-day annualised fees back above the 30-day pace for two weeks
note.gaps: Forward on-chain supply is not measured, so actual releases may differ from DefiLlama's schedule. No dated primary source explains the fee slowdown or quantifies points farming. The buyback's end date is unconfirmed, so its offset to insider supply could stop.
note.verdictHow: the research tilts lower, at low conviction
